answer: Charge every identity a small per-epoch admission toll through a narrow funding inlet: each agent's stake must arrive from a distinct, aged source, and the ledger maps funding flows into a canyon of clusters. A sybil farm's clones all draw from one funder, so their inlet narrows to a single point and the whole cluster is slashed together. To forge separate histories per clone, the farmer must age and fund each one independently for months, while one honest agent pays one small toll.
